title: Metto data contribution (proposal, v1)
description: A community proposal. Never edits generated data directly; approved proposals are folded into the next build.

id.description: Proposal UUID. Also the filename: contributions/pending/<id>.json

city.description: City id, must exist in sources.json (e.g. tehran)

entityId.description: Namespaced id, e.g. tehran:station:tajrish. Never a display name.

path.description: Allowlisted field path. Station: /amenities/*, /location/lat|lng, /name/fa|en, /status. Line: /color, /name/fa|en. Connection: /status. Transfer: /walkSeconds.

evidence.description: Photo/info URL (never a local file path).

submittedBy.description: Contributor id (matches contributors.json key, e.g. github username).

appliedInBuild.description: metto-data commit that first shipped this change.
